title: Built a Nasdaq scalping EA with Sharpe 4.46 and 5.91% max DD — 7 years real tick data backtest
author: Logical-Analyst9659
selftext:
Been working on this for a while. M5 timeframe, NY session only, no overnight positions, no martingale, no grid.    
Stats from real tick data Dec 2018 – Apr 2026:    
	•	Sharpe Ratio: 4.46    
	•	Max Drawdown: 5.91%    
	•	Recovery Factor: 5.83    
	•	Profit Factor: 1.31    
	•	Total Trades: 669    
	•	Win Rate: 44.25%    
Strategy uses KAMA combined with opening range bias detection and price box breakouts. Curious what the community thinks about the results and methodology.
